_comment: The daily card (Chimora 1.3.2, Ali): shown once a day in the world, never in battle. gift: the 7-day welcome gift, one step per day the game is opened; a missed day costs nothing, the cycle only moves on when a gift is taken (LoginGift.gd). Each step gives item x count and/or coins; step 7 is the big one. gift_rg: the free Riftglass of the day by the same step, paid by the server (public.rg_daily_claim, server_config 'daily_gift', migration 20261128060000_daily_gift_cycle.sql; tests/unit/test_daily_card.gd compares them). featured_mult: weight factor of the Spirling of the day on the tables where it lives (DailySpirling.gd, catch rate unchanged). weekend: special weather on Saturday and Sunday (local date) on a few outdoor maps, per_weekend events drawn from the Saturday's date; kind is a WeatherCycle kind, species are shy kinds of those maps that step out mult times as often (WeekendSky.gd).
